svg.title: T-cell development in the thymus
svg.desc: A haematopoietic stem cell from the bone marrow seeds the thymus, where early thymocytes rearrange their T-cell receptor genes by V(D)J recombination, express a T-cell receptor and are tested by positive and negative selection; the survivors leave as naive CD4 and CD8 T cells for the lymph nodes and spleen.
